budget_scope: exact rounded top-b independently per layer and sequence
reward_data: next four batches in the same pregenerated ordinary training stream, subsequently consumed for body training
execution: hard top-b; ordinary gather/scatter; dense hard-output masking only on differentiable meta-steps
accounting: executed matmul/attention FLOPs via FlopCounterMode, separated into train/meta/eval; all wallclock recorded
level2_descriptive_gate: meta sparse held-out loss below both random and shuffled at step 200
level3_descriptive_gate: meta sparse held-out loss below dense-fewer at dense-fewer total training cost
confirmation: none; fresh seeds and frozen settings required after any development success
stopping: no hyperparameter sweep and no extension based on observed outcomes
